usage: Generated transparent 3D metal insignia for the reward screen; original PNGs preserved, runtime WebP assets encoded at 384 px.

badges.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium 3D game inventory badge icon, isolated on actual transparent alpha, square composition, no text, no letters, no numbers, no surrounding scene. A compact octagonal industrial module housing with thick beveled gray-blue gunmetal armor, restrained brushed metal, a few warm copper corner clamps and cold cyan energy insets. A clearly recognizable chunky embossed central mechanism, NOT an abstract line icon, readable at 64px. Nearly front-facing, slightly top-down orthographic view, consistent upper-left studio key light, realistic dimensional edges, clean stylized low-poly science-fiction strategy-game equipment aesthetic. Fill about 82 percent of the image with generous transparent edge padding. No excessive glow or sparks. Centered, symmetric frame. Dark blue metal, silver-blue edge highlights, warm copper accents and icy cyan luminous cores. Icon subject: a stout hexagonal cyan energy core socketed into an octagonal armor plate, with two small copper laurel-like armor fins at its lower sides. This is the master insignia for tactical modules.
